results.content: # A survey on concept drift adaptation. title={A survey on concept drift adaptation},. The survey covers the different facets of concept drift in an integrated way to reflect on the existing scattered state of the art and aims at providing a comprehensive introduction to the concept drift adaptation for researchers, industry analysts, and practitioners. ### Concept drift adaptation for learning with streaming data. ### A Review on Concept Drift. ### A Review on Dynamic Concept Drift. ### A Survey on Classification of Concept Drift with Stream Data. An unsupervised concept drift detection and adaptation framework based on random forest and Kullback-Leibler divergence is proposed, referred to as RFKL, which reduces reliance on labeled data and enhancing classifier robustness in dynamic settings. ### Learning under Concept Drift: A Review. A high quality, instructive review of current research developments and trends in the concept drift field is conducted, and a framework of learning under concept drift is established including three main components: concept drift detection, concept drift understanding, and concept drift adaptation.
